title.en: Chapter 27 — The Elephant Who Carried Me

book_meta.work: The Seven Voyages of Sindbad, from ألف ليلة وليلة
book_meta.author: traditional

sentences.ar: مشى الفيل نص يوم، وأنا على ظهره.
sentences.en: The elephant walked half a day, with me on its back.

sentences.ar: لحد ما وصلنا على تلة، ووقف، ونزلني بخرطومه على مهل.
sentences.en: Until we reached a hill, and it stopped, and set me down gently with its trunk.
And it went, it and all the elephants, and left me.
I stood, looked around, and did not understand.
And then I understood.
The hill was all ivory.

sentences.ar: أنياب فيلة، مئات، آلاف، أبيض وأصفر، قديم وجديد.
sentences.en: Elephant tusks, hundreds, thousands, white and yellow, old and new.
It was the elephants' graveyard.

sentences.ar: المكان اللي بيجوا يموتوا فيه من ألف سنة.
sentences.en: The place they had come to die for a thousand years.

sentences.ar: وفهمت شو قال لي الفيل، بلا كلام.
sentences.en: And I understood what the elephant had told me, without words.
It said: you want ivory?
Here is ivory.
Take it, and let us live.
And I sat on the hill, and wept.
I went back to my master on foot, two days.
And when he saw me, he said: I thought you dead!
The elephants pulled up the tree!
I said: come with me.
And I took him to the hill.

sentences.ar: ووقف قدام العاج، وما حكى نص ساعة.
sentences.en: And he stood before the ivory, and did not speak for half an hour.

sentences.ar: وبعدين قال: يا سندباد، هاد كتير.
sentences.en: And then he said: Sindbad, this is a lot.

sentences.ar: أكتر مما بيجمعه بلدنا بمية سنة.
sentences.en: More than our country gathers in a hundred years.
And you are a slave no more.
You are free, and you are my partner.

sentences.ar: وما حدا بيقتل فيل بعد اليوم.
sentences.en: And no one kills an elephant from this day.

sentences.ar: وحملنا العاج على فيلة، مش زي قبل، بس اللي تحتاجه القافلة.
sentences.en: And we carried the ivory on elephants, not as before, only what the caravan needed.
And he sold it, gave me half, and a ship, and bade me farewell.
And I sailed, and nothing happened.

sentences.ar: ولا عاصفة، ولا قراصنة، ولا جزيرة.
sentences.en: No storm, no pirates, no island.

sentences.ar: لأول مرة بحياتي، البحر رجعني عالبيت بسلام.
sentences.en: For the first time in my life, the sea brought me home in peace.
And the porter said: why?

sentences.ar: قال السندباد: يمكن لأني ما أخدت إلا اللي بحتاجه.
sentences.en: Sindbad said: perhaps because I took only what I needed.
